description:
Computes backscatter from SAR input.

Note that backscatter computation may require instrument specific metadata that is tightly coupled to the original SAR products. As a result, this process may only work in combination with loading data from specific collections, not with general data cubes.

This process uses bilinear interpolation, both for resampling the DEM and the backscatter.

**Phase 1 support (this back-end).** Only Sentinel-1 GRD, ellipsoid-only geometry: `coefficient` in `beta0`, `sigma0-ellipsoid`, `gamma0-ellipsoid`, or `null`. `sigma0-terrain`/`gamma0-terrain` (the spec default), `elevation_model`, `contributing_area`, and `local_incidence_angle` are not yet supported and raise an error rather than being approximated. See docs/adr/0001-sar-backscatter.md.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: The source data cube containing SAR input.

parameters.name: coefficient
parameters.description:
Select the radiometric correction coefficient. The following options are available:

* `beta0`: radar brightness
* `sigma0-ellipsoid`: ground area computed with ellipsoid earth model
* `sigma0-terrain`: ground area computed with terrain earth model (**not supported in Phase 1**)
* `gamma0-ellipsoid`: ground area computed with ellipsoid earth model in sensor line of sight
* `gamma0-terrain`: ground area computed with terrain earth model in sensor line of sight (spec default; **not supported in Phase 1** -- callers must opt into an ellipsoid coefficient explicitly)
* `null`: non-normalized backscatter

parameters.name: elevation_model
parameters.description: The digital elevation model to use. The default value `null` allows the back-end to choose, which will improve portability, but reduce reproducibility. **Phase 1 supports only `null`** -- no DEM is used (ellipsoid geometry only).

parameters.name: mask
parameters.description: If set to `true`, a data mask is added to the bands with the name `mask`. It indicates which values are valid (1), invalid (0), or contain a no-data value.

parameters.name: contributing_area
parameters.description: If set to `true`, a DEM-based local contributing area band named `contributing_area` is added. The values are given in square meters. **Not supported in Phase 1.**

parameters.name: local_incidence_angle
parameters.description: If set to `true`, a DEM-based local incidence angle band named `local_incidence_angle` is added. The values are given in degrees. **Not supported in Phase 1.**

parameters.name: ellipsoid_incidence_angle
parameters.description: If set to `true`, an ellipsoidal incidence angle band named `ellipsoid_incidence_angle` is added. The values are given in degrees.

parameters.name: noise_removal
parameters.description: If set to `false`, no noise removal is applied. Defaults to `true`, which removes noise.
Proprietary options for the backscatter computations. Specifying proprietary options will reduce portability.
parameters.name: options

returns.description: Backscatter values corresponding to the chosen parametrization. The values are given in linear scale.

DigitalElevationModelInvalid.message: The digital elevation model specified is either not a DEM or can't be used with the data cube given.

ProcessParameterInvalid.message: The value passed for parameter 'coefficient' is invalid, or the input data cube does not meet the requirements of this process (e.g. missing calibration/noise assets).

FeatureUnsupported.message: The requested feature (contributing_area or local_incidence_angle) is not supported by this back-end.
